clusters.reason: The PR explicitly states that NUL bytes inside UBJSON/BJData high-precision number payloads should be rejected with parse_error.115 rather than being accepted based on a prefix.
This case tests a high-precision number payload containing a trailing NUL byte, which the PR description specifically lists as a regression case now correctly rejected with parse_error.115.
The PR ensures that a NUL encountered within a high-precision payload reports the exact byte offset of the NUL (byte 4) rather than treating it as a standard end of input check after lexing.
This is a nested array regression case mentioned in the PR description, correctly rejected when containing a malformed high-precision number with a NUL byte.

The PR changes the high-precision payload reading loop to detect NUL bytes immediately during reading, causing it to report parse_error.115 at the NUL byte instead of reaching a later end-of-input error.
